name: West start
label: Start
description: West end of Water Eaton Road, by the level crossing over the main line. Open ground and the backs of Duncombe Street to the north. Station Footpath is about 220 m away, Oliver Road about 290 m.

name: East start
label: Start
description: East end of Water Eaton Road, by the roadworks barriers. Clifford Avenue runs north from here. Oliver Road is about 280 m away, Station Footpath about 330 m.

name: Station Footpath
description: North-west corner: the lane up to Bletchley station. The army's old cordon point D1, left when the soldiers withdrew, by an abandoned police car. Find the red smoke, then stand in the green zone for 10 seconds.

name: Oliver Road
description: Top of Oliver Road, at the hoarding by the old Sainsbury's: the army's old cordon point D2. Red smoke marks it. Stand in the green zone for 10 seconds.

name: Scav spawn S-01
label: S-01
description: Duncombe Street, just south of the Osborne Street junction. Covers the road both ways.

name: Scav spawn S-02
label: S-02
description: Back gardens on the west side of Duncombe Street, by the corner houses.

name: Scav spawn S-03
label: S-03
description: South side of Osborne Street, between the semis. Close to two open houses.

name: Scav spawn S-04
label: S-04
description: Middle of the car park. Marked as a lookout: long sightlines, no cover.

name: Scav spawn S-05
label: S-05
description: South end of Clifford Avenue. Watches the road and the open house on the corner.

name: Scav spawn S-06
label: S-06
description: Southern stretch of Duncombe Street, by the burning barrel and an open end-terrace.

name: Scav spawn S-07
label: S-07
description: Eastern half of the car park, right next to a crate spot.

name: Scav spawn S-08
label: S-08
description: Grass strip at the corner of the old Sainsbury's. Overlooks the car park and the gardens behind Osborne Street.

name: Scav spawn S-09
label: S-09
description: Where Osborne Street meets Oliver Road, on the way to the Oliver Road exit.

name: Scav spawn S-10
label: S-10
description: Open ground by the railway, west of the back gardens. Sound carries a long way here.

name: Scav spawn S-11
label: S-11
description: West end of Osborne Street, near the Duncombe Street junction.

name: Scav spawn S-12
label: S-12
description: Overgrown back gardens behind Clifford Avenue, just south of the two-storey house.

name: Scav spawn S-13
label: S-13
description: Inside the old Sainsbury's, at the back on the east side. Part of the scav camp, and it keeps close to home.

name: Scav spawn S-14
label: S-14
description: Inside the old Sainsbury's, near the front shutter. Part of the scav camp.

name: Crate C-01
description: Upstairs in the open house at the north end of the railway-side terrace.

name: Crate C-02
description: Out in the car park, with no cover while you search it. S-07 spawns next to it.

name: Crate C-03
description: Back gardens north of the Osborne Street terrace, by a shed.

name: Crate C-04
description: Back gardens north of the Osborne Street terrace.

name: Crate C-05
description: Back gardens north of the Osborne Street terrace, by a shed.

name: Crate C-07
description: Inside Bagshot Court, the retirement flats off Clifford Avenue, downstairs. Walk in by the back porch.

name: Crate C-08
description: Upstairs in the open house on the corner of Osborne Street and Clifford Avenue.

name: Crate C-09
description: Upstairs in the open semi on the south side of Osborne Street.

name: Crate C-10
description: Downstairs in the two-storey house. The field copy flags it for loot.

name: Crate C-11
description: By a shed out on the open ground, west of the gardens.

name: Crate C-12
description: Upstairs in the open semi on Clifford Avenue.

name: Crate C-13
description: Back garden on the west side of the Duncombe Street terrace.

name: Crate C-14
description: Upstairs in the open end-terrace on the east side of Duncombe Street.

name: Crate C-15
description: Upstairs in the open house towards the south end of Clifford Avenue.

name: Crate C-16
description: Upstairs in the open house at the south end of Duncombe Street.

name: Crate C-17
description: Upstairs in the open house on the south side of Water Eaton Road.

name: Crate C-18
description: Upstairs in Bagshot Court. Take the stairs from the hall.

name: Crate C-19
description: Inside the old Sainsbury's, towards the front of the store. Often food and drink.

name: Crate C-20
description: Inside the old Sainsbury's. Often medical kit.

name: Crate C-21
description: Inside the old Sainsbury's, at the back on the west side.

name: Crate C-22
description: Inside the old Sainsbury's, at the back on the east side.

name: Crate C-23
description: In the foundations of the abandoned housing site on Clifford Avenue, where the kitchen would have been. Get in where a fence panel has come down.

name: Crate C-24
description: In The Park, the looted pub at the end of the Station footpath.

name: Crate C-25
description: In the army camp behind Bagshot Court, inside the big headquarters tent. Worth the walk.

name: Railway terrace, north end
description: End house of the terrace that backs onto the railway. Crate C-01 is upstairs.

name: Osborne Street semi
description: South side of Osborne Street. Crate C-09 is upstairs.

name: Clifford Avenue corner house
description: Where Osborne Street turns into Clifford Avenue. Crate C-08 is upstairs.

name: The two-storey
description: Set back among the trees behind Osborne Street. Two floors and crate C-10. S-03 and S-12 both spawn close by.

name: Clifford Avenue semi
description: West side of Clifford Avenue. Crate C-12 is upstairs.

name: Duncombe Street end-terrace
description: East side of Duncombe Street, by the burning barrel. Crate C-14 is upstairs.

name: Duncombe Street, south end
description: Last houses before Water Eaton Road. Crate C-16 is upstairs.

name: Clifford Avenue, south
description: West side of Clifford Avenue, near S-05. Crate C-15 is upstairs.

name: Water Eaton Road house
description: South side of Water Eaton Road, the nearest open house to the east start. Crate C-17 is upstairs.

name: The car park
description: The old Sainsbury's car park. Open ground with no cover and long sightlines. Cross it quickly or go round the edge.

name: The old Sainsbury's
description: The big supermarket north of the car park, stripped bare and taken over by scavs. Get in under the stuck front shutter, by the back fire door or through goods-in. Four crates inside, and two scavs (S-13 and S-14) camp there. Its hoarding marks the Oliver Road exit.

name: MK Jamee Masjid
description: The masjid in the terrace on the west side of Duncombe Street. A useful landmark when you're navigating the gardens.

name: The railway
description: The West Coast Main Line runs down the west edge of the raid. Out of bounds past the fence. Movement near the tracks is noisy and carries a long way.

name: Community house
description: On Duncombe Street, by the way into the car park.

name: Bagshot Court
description: The retirement flats off Clifford Avenue, rebuilt with an upstairs. In by the back porch; crates C-07 downstairs and C-18 upstairs. The army camp is just behind it.

name: The Brunel Centre
description: Black-glass shopping centre beside the old Sainsbury's, with a palisade service yard between them. Out of bounds to the north, but its glass can be shot out from the car park.

name: The Park
description: A looted corner pub at the end of the Station footpath, by the exit. Walk in through the bar; crate C-24 is inside.

name: Building site
description: The abandoned building site along the north hoarding: cabins, scaffold, a skip and a tower crane over half-built flats.

name: Clifford Avenue housing site
description: An abandoned housing site with foundations laid a few courses high. Crate C-23 is inside the foundations.

name: Level crossing
description: The Water Eaton Road half-barrier crossing over the main line, by the west start. One barrier is down, the other snapped off.

name: Army camp
description: Tents the soldiers left on the Bagshot Court car park, inside the hoarding at the east end of Osborne Street. Crate C-25 is in the headquarters tent.

name: Army checkpoint
description: The checkpoint at the east end of Osborne Street: a gate, HESCO towers and a hut. The gate is shut, so this is no way out.
